laws.rule: Sharjah bans buying, selling, holding and drinking alcohol, including in hotels and restaurants. UAE federal law also bans drinking in public and being drunk in public anywhere in the UAE. Each emirate's own rules are published in its official gazette.
Smartraveller says Islamic law is enforced in Sharjah and Ajman, and asks visitors to dress modestly there, with clothing that covers the shoulders and knees.
laws.heading: Smartraveller travel advice

laws.rule: Smartraveller says you can't carry alcohol in your car if you are driving through Sharjah or crossing the border from Oman into Sharjah. Sharjah is 'dry': the sale or consumption of alcohol is illegal.
laws.heading: Smartraveller travel advice

laws.rule: Smartraveller says sex and living together outside marriage (for people over 18) have been decriminalised in every emirate except Sharjah. Adultery is illegal across the UAE.
